preconditions.description: Initial heads (h), tails (t), and limit (R) are within bounds and h + t > 0

preconditions.expression: 1 <= n <= 200 and all(1 <= i <= n for i in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Number of head-cutting rules (n) is valid, and each rule corresponds to cutting 1..n heads

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= hi <= 200 and 0 <= ti <= 200 for hi, ti in head_growth_rules)
preconditions.description: Head growth rules (hi, ti) are non-negative and bounded by 200

preconditions.expression: 1 <= m <= 200 and all(1 <= j <= m for j in range(1, m + 1))
preconditions.description: Number of tail-cutting rules (m) is valid, and each rule corresponds to cutting 1..m tails

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= hj <= 200 and 0 <= tj <= 200 for hj, tj in tail_growth_rules)
preconditions.description: Tail growth rules (hj, tj) are non-negative and bounded by 200

postconditions.expression: (outcome == 'Ivan' and blows >= 1) or (outcome == 'Zmey' and blows >= 1) or (outcome == 'Draw')
postconditions.description: Output is either 'Ivan' with blow count, 'Zmey' with blow count, or 'Draw'

postconditions.expression: outcome == 'Ivan' if exists(sequence of moves leading to (h=0 and t=0) in <= R blows) else (outcome == 'Zmey' if all possible moves lead to h + t > R eventually) else outcome == 'Draw'
postconditions.description: Ivan wins if he can reduce heads and tails to zero in finite moves; otherwise, Zmey wins if Ivan cannot indefinitely resist; otherwise, it's a Draw

postconditions.expression: blows == min(steps) if outcome == 'Ivan' else blows == max(steps) if outcome == 'Zmey' else True
postconditions.description: Blows count is minimal for Ivan's win, maximal for Zmey's win, or irrelevant for Draw
